name: Create Rail Sounds
description: Railroad mod for Create: live train sounds, realistic shunting (keybind coupling, flying switches, coasting cuts, buffers, yard rules), plus working railroad blocks - cargo sensor, car counter, loading hatch, 3-aspect searchlight signals, defect detectors, speed limit signs, crossing signals and gates, car retarders, switch stands, switch machines, route sensors, an interlocking panel and the Switch Linker - and trackside decor. Must be installed on the server AND every client.
